symptom: Running unchanged `describe javascript action` output (now `create or modify`) on a project with the .js sources regenerated the file: the import list (`import { Big } from "big.js"`) and the EXTRA CODE helpers (deg2rad) were dropped and the signature re-spelled, so NanoflowCommons.GetStraightLineDistance's user code called functions that no longer existed
cause: execCreateJavaScriptAction always called WriteJavaScriptSourceFile, and GenerateJavaScriptSource has no slot for the imports or EXTRA CODE (the Java twin retains both, #705). A plain `create` refused on an existing action, which is what had hidden it
insight: The PedApp round trip could not see this: PedApp ships no javascriptsource, so describe printed the placeholder body and the file path was never exercised. Snapshot the source tree as well as mprcontents when round-tripping a doctype that owns files. Leaving the file alone when the statement restates the stored user code and parameter names fixes describe->exec; an edited body still regenerates without the retained sections
